statement: The operation_workflow_owner engages the operation-ledger self-move DEFER hold (which excludes dependent priority ADD admission) only from the point the self-move is dispatch-admissible — its target has a current READY lease and CREATE_REPLICA is about to be sent — not at createOperation time while the ledger raft group is still untouched; before that point plannable dependent priority control-plane ADDs are admitted under the existing budget and the self-move's IDLE_ONLY admission makes it wait for the ledger to be idle exactly as when dependents are planned first. The exclusion while the self-move is live, the IDLE_ONLY rule, the quorum_concentrated deferral, maxConcurrentAdds, CRITICAL_CHECK_DELAY_MS, the 60-second GCP certification window, the failed-repair backoff, and the single cluster-ACTIVE authority are unchanged. Proven by the real-owner witness scenario self-move-planned-before-adds (seed ledger concentrated forcing a count-neutral REPLACE created 3.5s before five priority ADDs are planned, target READY at +14s): red on HEAD (dependents refused operation_ledger_self_move_in_flight from +3.5s to +62s, joiners not READY inside 60s), green after (dependents acked by about +30s, joiners READY inside 60s). Root cause from the GCP streak on 675d6b512: runs 21-08-21 and 21-22-08 failed with the hold covering 29.9s and 57.8s of the window (self-move created before the ADDs), run 21-16-04 passed at about 45s with ADDs planned first.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The operation_workflow_owner (RebalanceCoordinator + OperationWorkflowOwner, operation-ledger-hold-policy.js + rebalance-coordinator-ledger-interlock-admission.js) stays the sole owner of hold engagement, IDLE_ONLY/DEFER admission, claim, and dispatch; planners, readiness owners, and the harness observe and never re-derive admission.

From the moment the self-move is dispatch-admissible until its terminal, dependent admission is excluded exactly as today (operation_ledger_self_move_in_flight); the IDLE_ONLY rule (self-move admits only into an idle ledger, waiting_for_idle_ledger) and the quorum_concentrated deferral are byte-for-byte preserved; dt6-rebalancer-formation-self-move-interlock and the other dt6 ledger witnesses stay green.

maxConcurrentAdds, CRITICAL_CHECK_DELAY_MS and other scheduler cadences, the 60-second GCP certification window and its owner-progress extension, and the failed-repair backoff are unchanged. No sleeps, timeout widening, retry widening, or readiness weakening.

Prove the cure through the real-owner witness (real RebalanceCoordinator + OperationWorkflowOwner + ledger interlock + startup authority, virtual clock) red on HEAD and green after, before any GCP run; the GCP streak is certification, never an iteration loop.
Do not make the harness, analyzer, or readiness owner derive cluster-ACTIVE or READY from nodes.status, publication counts, or coverage.
